ShortDescription.Value: An add-on for Realistic Aviation: weather reports (METAR) and ATIS for your airports.

Publish.LongDescription:
# EN> This mod is an add-on for Realistic Aviation. It adds weather reports (METAR) and ATIS to airports.
# KO> 이 모드는 Realistic Aviation의 애드온이며, 공항에 기상정보(METAR)와 ATIS를 추가합니다.
Publish.ChangeLog:
1.1 - Uses the new Realistic Aviation add-on API (needs Realistic Aviation 1.1). - An airport closed by another add-on gives that reason in its ATIS.
1.1 - Realistic Aviation의 새 애드온 API를 씁니다 (Realistic Aviation 1.1 필요). - 다른 애드온이 공항을 닫으면 그 사유가 ATIS에 나옵니다.
